usgs_base_url.description: The base URL for the USGS Inventory API service. Default is the official public endpoint.

usgs_api_token.description: API authentication token for authenticated access. Leave empty to use interactive login or env vars.

usgs_results_per_page.description: Maximum number of search results returned per page. Valid values are typically 5, 10, 25, 50, or 100.

usgs_max_cloud_cover.description: Maximum percentage of cloud cover allowed for scenes in search results (0-100).

usgs_download_dir.description: Local directory path where downloaded scenes will be saved.

usgs_export_format.description: Default file format for exporting search results. Options include CSV, KMZ, Shapefile, FGDC.

usgs_start_date.description: Start date for search queries in YYYY-MM-DD format.

usgs_end_date.description: End date for search queries in YYYY-MM-DD format.
